## Appearance

George Moore possesses a unique physical feature consisting of one blue eye and one hazel eye. He also bears a very striking resemblance to his cousin, [Dick Moore](../character/dick.md).

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 31 THE TRUTH MAKES FREE P28](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0028), [v4 CHAPTER 32 MISS CORNELIA DISCUSSES THE AFFAIR P12](../source/v04-c32.md#nw-v04-c32-p0012)_

## Personality

George Moore is characterized as a thoroughly nice individual. At the same time, he possesses a pronounced streak of mischief.

## History

Eighteen years prior to his operation, George Moore visited his Uncle Abner when he and his cousin [Dick](../character/dick.md) were around seventeen years old. Before sailing on the [Four Sisters](../codex/tech.md#four-sisters), he became engaged to a girl at home, and he later stayed behind in Cuba to nurse [Dick](../character/dick.md). For years, he was mistaken for [Dick Moore](../character/dick.md) until an operation performed in [Montreal](../codex/places.md#montreal) restored his memory, revealing his true identity as Dick's cousin George Moore while the real [Dick](../character/dick.md) had died years earlier. Following the recovery of his memory, his sister took him home to [Nova Scotia](../codex/places.md#nova-scotia).

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 31 THE TRUTH MAKES FREE P3](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0003), [v4 CHAPTER 31 THE TRUTH MAKES FREE P4](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0004), [v4 CHAPTER 31 THE TRUTH MAKES FREE P6](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0006), [v4 CHAPTER 31 THE TRUTH MAKES FREE P9](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0009), [v4 CHAPTER 31 THE TRUTH MAKES FREE P11](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0011), [v4 CHAPTER 31 THE TRUTH MAKES FREE P17](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0017), +21 more_

## Relationships

### [Dick](../character/dick.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/dick--george-moore.md)

George Moore is the cousin of the real [Dick Moore](../character/dick.md). For years, [George](../character/george.md) was mistaken for [Dick](../character/dick.md) until an operation in [Montreal](../codex/places.md#montreal) restored his memory. This surgery revealed that [Dick](../character/dick.md) had actually died years earlier, clarifying George's true identity.

- Relative of — cousin  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LESLIE MOORE P28](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0028), [v4 CHAPTER 31 THE TRUTH MAKES FREE P28](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0028), [v4 CHAPTER 32 MISS CORNELIA DISCUSSES THE AFFAIR P12](../source/v04-c32.md#nw-v04-c32-p0012), +1 more</sub>

### [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/george-moore--leslie-moore.md)

[Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md) originally cared for [George](../character/george.md) under the belief that he was her brain-damaged husband, [Dick](../character/dick.md). After [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) brought him to [Montreal](../codex/places.md#montreal) for an operation, George's memory returned, revealing his true identity as Dick's cousin and freeing [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) from her marital burden. Following his recovery, George's sister took him back to [Nova Scotia](../codex/places.md#nova-scotia), though he and [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) remain in contact through letters.

- Friend of — corresponds with him by letter  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 36 BEAUTY FOR ASHES P10](../source/v04-c36.md#nw-v04-c36-p0010)</sub>
